bagPolicy.summary: Portland’5 uses touchless screening that allows guests to carry a bag without emptying it. Its general attending guide does not specify a bag dimension or require clear bags; some individual events publish additional restrictions.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: Consult Keller Auditorium’s venue-specific parking and directions page for nearby garages and drop-off details. Parking capacity and price depend on the event.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The Keller parking and general event guide do not specify a designated app-based rideshare zone.

concessions.summary: Lobby concessions sell snacks, drinks and alcohol and accept cards; free cash-to-card machines are available. Outside food and drinks are prohibited, and lidded drinks are usually allowed into the auditorium.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: Keller offers accessibility information including seating, guest services and accessible parking. Some historic seating areas require steps, so confirm the accessible seating location when booking.

reEntry.summary: The venue’s attending and accessibility pages do not state a general re-entry rule.

ticketPickup.summary: The venue’s general attending guide does not publish a standard will-call time or pickup procedure; check the specific show and the ticket confirmation.
